regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-directional rotation with Oil & Gas Producers as the narrow leader (score 1.05, but durability bar only 0.5, mixed Hurst, breadth 0.357) and Consumer Staples & Retail as the closest challenger (score 0.932, durability 0.81, trend, breadth 1.0). The absolute-trend gate is the only validated leg (gate_helps=true), and the track record dir_accuracy of 0.313 is weak — so all leans default low conviction and should be framed as conditionals, not forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Consumer Staples & Retail overtakes Oil & Gas Producers as the leader: if XST.TO's score exceeds XEG.TO's score and XST.TO maintains breadth above 0.9 with durability above 0.8 for 10 consecutive trading days, that would be a confirmed leadership handoff worth re-assessing.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples & Retail shows the strongest combination of trend-gate eligibility, durability (0.81, highest among eligible leaders), Hurst 'trend', and breadth 1.0. The validated absolute-trend gate is the only leg with forward risk-control value, and this theme passes it cleanly; it is the challenger with more stable participation than the Oil & Gas leader (breadth 0.357 vs 1.0).
theses.dissent: The strongest contrary case is that Consumer Staples & Retail is the challenger, not the leader, and the leader has not yet handed off — the rotation leg is display-only with no validated early-handoff forecast; a defensive theme may simply be a short-term overflow from Oil & Gas leadership rather than an independent trend.

falsifier.text: XST.TO price trend breaks and the 5-day return undercuts the S&P/TSX benchmark materially while Oil & Gas extends its lead beyond a 0.15 point score spread before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks pass the absolute-trend gate (eligible true) with high durability (0.8), Hurst 'trend', and breadth 1.0. This is a trend-following, vol-aware lean on a theme with stable participation, consistent with the one validated edge — drawdown/shake-out avoidance via the gate.
theses.dissent: The strongest contrary case is that Big Banks is a crowded proxy for the broad TSX itself — its leadership may simply be the market's beta, and the detector's rank-IC of ~0 means the rank lens is not alpha; if the broad tape rolls over, Big Banks will not offer downside protection.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XST.TO and XEG.TO materially over any rolling 20-day window while the absolute-trend gate flips to ineligible before the check-by date

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is tied with Telecom for the lowest crowding_z (-0.37), passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible true), and shows trend Hurst with durability 0.77. This is a low-crowding trend continuation lean in a vol-aware framework.
theses.dissent: The strongest contrary case is that Utilities & Renewables is a rate-sensitive theme with weak momentum (score 0.335) — the hurdle is much lower than leader/challenger, and a mean-reversion in rates or a shift back to high-beta energy would quickly undercut the trend.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO absolute momentum turns negative over a 20-day window while the absolute-trend gate flips ineligible before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
